figs.name: nitrogen-purging-pipeline-displacement-diagram
figs.alt: nitrogen purging of a pipeline by displacement with vent and oxygen analyzer
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing nitrogen from a regulated supply pushing air, oxygen and moisture out of a pipeline through a vent, checked by an oxygen analyzer.

<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Nitrogen Purging of a Pipeline</text>

<text x="90.0" y="204.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">N2 supply</text>

<circle cx="200" cy="210" r="22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<path d="M188 222 L212 198" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>

<polygon points="250,197 270,210 250,223" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/><polygon points="290,197 270,210 290,223" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="270" y="178" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inlet valve</text>

<line x1="300" y1="190" x2="690" y2="190" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>

figs.name: nitrogen-purging-working-sequence-flowchart
figs.alt: nitrogen purging flowchart from nitrogen inlet to vent and oxygen check
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how nitrogen purging works: nitrogen enters, pushes out air, gases vent and purging continues until oxygen reaches a safe level.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Nitrogen purging working sequence flowchart from inlet to oxygen check</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a Nitrogen Purge Runs</text>
<rect x="80" y="55" width="360" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fef9c3" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="260.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Permit, PPE, oxygen monitors</text>
<line x1="260" y1="113" x2="260" y2="133" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="80" y="135" width="360" height="58" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="260.0" y="158.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Inlet</text>
<text x="260.0" y="182.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">dry nitrogen enters system</text>
<line x1="260" y1="193" x2="260" y2="213" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="80" y="215" width="360" height="58" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="260.0" y="238.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Displace or dilute</text>
<text x="260.0" y="262.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">nitrogen pushes air and gases</text>
<line x1="260" y1="273" x2="260" y2="293" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="80" y="295" width="360" height="58" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="260.0" y="318.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Vent</text>
<text x="260.0" y="342.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">displaced gases exit outlet</text>
<line x1="260" y1="353" x2="260" y2="373" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="260,375.0 420.0,425 260,475.0 100.0,425" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="260" y="420.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Oxygen at</text>
<text x="260" y="442.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">safe level?</text>
<line x1="420" y1="425" x2="498" y2="425" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="458" y="415" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="500" y="393" width="280" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="640.0" y="419.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Keep purging</text>
<text x="640.0" y="443.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">check dead legs and flow</text>
<polyline points="640,393 640,244 442,244" fill="none" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
<line x1="260" y1="475" x2="260" y2="503" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="274" y="494" font-size="17" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="80" y="505" width="360" height="64" rx="10" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="260.0" y="531.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Confirm with analyzer</text>
<text x="260.0" y="555.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">then hand over or blanket</text>
<rect x="490" y="55" width="290" height="160" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="506" y="89" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">3 ways to lower O2</text>
<text x="506" y="123" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Displacement: pipelines</text>
<text x="506" y="153" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Dilution: reactors, columns</text>
<text x="506" y="183" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Pressure and vent cycles</text>
</svg>

figs.name: nitrogen-purging-pressure-vent-cycle-chart
figs.alt: nitrogen purging pressure and vent cycle chart oxygen 21 to 0.17 percent
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing oxygen falling from 21 to 4.2, 0.84 and 0.17 percent over three nitrogen cycles from 5 bar to 1 bar absolute.
figs.after_h2: Nitrogen Purging Meaning in Simple Words, With Key Terms
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 530" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Oxygen level after each nitrogen pressure and vent cycle from 5 bar to 1 bar</title>
<rect width="800" height="530" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pressure and Vent Cycles Cut Oxygen Fast</text>
<line x1="70" y1="430" x2="470" y2="430" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<rect x="90" y="180.1" width="60" height="249.9" rx="3" fill="#fb923c" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="120" y="170.1" font-size="19" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">21%</text>
<text x="120" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Air</text>
<rect x="190" y="380.02" width="60" height="49.980000000000004" rx="3" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="220" y="370.02" font-size="19" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4.2%</text>
<text x="220" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cycle 1</text>
<rect x="290" y="420.004" width="60" height="9.996" rx="3" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="320" y="410.004" font-size="19" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.84%</text>
<text x="320" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cycle 2</text>
<rect x="390" y="427.977" width="60" height="2.023" rx="3" fill="#0d9488" stroke="#115e59" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="420" y="417.977" font-size="19" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0.17%</text>
<text x="420" y="458" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Cycle 3</text>
<text x="270" y="90" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Oxygen in the vessel</text>
<rect x="495" y="70" width="290" height="305" rx="14" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0d9488" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="511" y="104" font-size="20" fill="#115e59" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">One cycle</text>
<text x="511" y="140" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Start: air at 1 bar abs</text>
<text x="511" y="172" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Pressurize to 5 bar abs</text>
<text x="511" y="204" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Vent back to 1 bar abs</text>
<text x="511" y="236" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">O2 fraction ÷ 5</text>
<text x="511" y="300" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">21 ÷ 5 = 4.2%</text>
<text x="511" y="332" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">4.2 ÷ 5 = 0.84%</text>
<text x="511" y="364" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">0.84 ÷ 5 ≈ 0.17%</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Always confirm the final value with an oxygen analyzer.</text>
</svg>
